description: This file defines the internal class GrainDirectoryResolver responsible for managing grain directory resolution within Orleans runtime, including default and specific directories based on grain types and properties.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryResolver
classes.description: Handles the registration, resolution, and management of grain directories within Orleans runtime, supporting default and custom directories based on grain types and properties.

methods.name: GrainDirectoryResolver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resolver with service provider, grain properties resolver, and registered resolvers.

methods.name: Directories
methods.description: Returns collection of all registered grain directories.

methods.name: DefaultGrainDirectory
methods.description: Property that provides the default grain directory.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate grain directory for a given grain type.

methods.name: IsUsingDefaultDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the grain type is using the default grain directory.

methods.name: GetGrainDirectoryPerType
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the grain directory associated with a specific grain type, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: TryGetNonDefaultGrainDirectory
methods.description: Attempts to determine a non-default grain directory based on properties and resolvers.
